title: Crossbar Layout Risk
plain_reading: A memory grid can distort values because wires, converters, and sliced weights are physical parts.
what_this_supports: CrossSim-style checks can show whether a proposed array layout is risky.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not prove the packaged chip, board, or thermal environment.
next_actions: Connect layout assumptions to the compiler mapping.
Block layout claims until simulation or silicon data exists.
